File.PrintText: I'm sorry! I had to take care of something for the student council...
Actually, I want your advice about something, and separately, I have a question for you.
The question? Uh... is there anything you want at the moment?
Anything I want? Well, I feel like having a croquette bun today.
N-no, I mean, other than for lunch.
You know, you sound just like Makoto.
It's just me and Mom in our family, you see.
A father? Well, I couldn't lend you mine.
There'd be no point in me just borrowing yours.
Well, they say the grass is always greener on the other side. It might just be a pain if I ever got one.
Mom always said that Dad was a hopeless good-for-nothing.
Well, there you have it. So...
Ah... well, that wasn't really what I meant...
Let's not go on about that.
So, what did you want my advice on?
Huh? Why are you going all red?
I've... been doing it with Makoto-kun.
No, I got that the first time.
At first, I hated the very idea of it, but...
He just kept having his way with me... and he's very good, so I couldn't help but enjoy myself.
Before I knew it, I was the one who wanted to do it, and he was the one who wasn't too interested...
It's quite embarrassing. Please don't tell anyone else.
Lately, I've always been the one approaching him, while he... seems kind of bored, I suppose.
On days when he doesn't feel like it, he even turns me down.
Maybe he doesn't find me attractive... it's kind of depressing.
That's not true. You're really cute.
Thank you. So what I've been thinking is this...
Perhaps what I need to do is create a fancy, anniversary-like time and occasion when he can't help but get excited.
It's December next month, isn't it?
So... it seems that my father is able to get a booking at the hotel in Sakakino Hills through his connections.
The Hills Hotel in that high-rise building? That's really high class, isn't it? I've seen it before on TV.
Yes. I was thinking of renting the presidential suite there on Christmas Eve...
and then, looking out at the city scenery, we'd become one.
...Just so I know, how much does one night cost at the presidential suite?
It's the busy season, so probably something like 400,000 yen.
400,000...?! You're going to borrow that much?
Yes. It's a little expensive... but it's a once in a lifetime experience.
But there's no way students like us could rent a room like that, right?!
Like I said, my father has connections. He said that even Christmas Eve would be fine.
Still, that's way too expensive for one night, isn't it? It's way more than what my mom makes in a month.
But you know... I asked my mother, and she said not to worry about money.
H-how you could talk to your mother about something like that...?
Do you think Makoto-kun would refuse?
No, I don't think he would.
Besides, he said that he'd make me some cloisonneware or silver jewelry...
It wouldn't feel right to give him anything less.
Makoto-kun's been somewhat distant lately... like he isn't really paying attention to me...
But if we renew our vows at this hotel at Christmas... we'll really become a couple. That's the feeling I get.
Because Christmas Eve is the time you spend with the person you treasure most.
That's why... I'm going to do my best to invite him!

File.name: 04-SA-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Paris, huh... wonder what sort of souvenirs she should get.
Souvenirs, huh... perfume would be nice.
Like she could buy one of those!
And besides, what souvenirs?! She's moving there with her mom, new school and everything. She's not coming back!
I know. But is it wrong to wish for her to come back once in a while? With souvenirs?
Well... I guess that'd be nice.
Wait, why am I seeing her off together with you, anyway?!
Well, Sekai's locked herself away, Kanroji has club and Taisuke overslept and didn't come.
That's not what I'm talking about! Listen, I-
T-that's right. It's because of you that Sekai's...
So, you're aware of what you're doing.
You and Taisuke went to the same junior high, didn't you?
Word is that you've liked him all this time.
Gyah! Y-you...! Who did... ah! Setsuna?!
What are you planning to do...?
There's something I want you to help me with.

File.name: 04-SA-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sekai? Are you taking today off, too?
With all these days off, are you sure you're going to have enough attendance days?
I suppose there's no helping it. Make sure you go to school tomorrow, okay?
Well, I'm leaving now. Make sure you eat properly.
Haah... another day of skipping school.
Eheheh... ah, here are some snacks.
Well, actually, it's just some cake from our place. Marron cake - the taste of autumn! Mont Blanc's got nothing on this!
Mmn... well, I wanted to talk to you about something. Come to think of it, this is the first time I've been here, isn't it?
Even though you've been to my house so many times.
You remember how Nanami loves cake, right? You'd all come over, and we'd all have cake together.
...Am I bothering you? You took the day off from school, so I was kind of reluctant to come... but Setsuna... you know...
I talked with Setsuna before she left, and she said to ask you.
You turned your phone off, right? I got the feeling that you didn't really want to answer it at the moment.
I guess I probably should have waited until you came back outside, but...
actually, mom's been bugging me to go back to school... so I was thinking about going tomorrow.
Ah... I see. Yeah, that's right. You've got to come. Everyone's worried about you.
Do you mind if I ask why you've shut yourself away? I think I can probably guess the answer, but still...
You were really close to Setsuna, weren't you? For such a small girl, she sure had a way of running the show.
So, about what I wanted to discuss with you...

File.name: 04-SA-B01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Oh, are you one of Sekai's friends...? I see.
Ah, sorry to have kept you waiting like that...
Sekai says she doesn't want to come out.
So... if you don't mind keeping an old woman company, why don't we have some tea together?
Hey, I haven't even asked your name yet. What is it?
Ahh... yes, yes, Makoto-kun, right? I see, so you're Makoto-kun... hmm...
I know all about you. After all, Sekai and Se-chan were...
I was never asleep! Stop talking about stuff like that!
Ehh? But it's the first time my daughter's brought a boy home. Just a little couldn't...
Makoto-kun, let's have a nice long talk afterwards.

File.name: 04-SA-B02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Listen... there's something I want to talk to you about.
The truth is... it's something I couldn't bring up with you after class.
Listen, we've got a little problem.
It's Taisuke... it seems he went and invited another girl at lunchtime, and she said 'yes'.
Yeah. Sawanaga's not a bad guy... but he's not the type who can just hit on a random girl and expect her to say yes.
No need to be so obtuse. You can just come out and say it: he's not popular.
Anyhow... now that mystery girl's coming to the pool, and we've only got four tickets...
But the whole point of this is to get Hikari and Taisuke to go on a date.
If that's the case, having another girl come along would be a problem.
Leave it to me. I've got a great plan.
You'll just have to wait and see.
Think you'll be able to start coming to school tomorrow?
Well, given what's happening with Hikari, I can't very well take the day off.

File.name: 04-SA-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What are you talking about? I'm asking you how that thing I requested about went.
W-why do you have to talk to me like that when there are people looking?!
Ah...! L-look, I'll tell you later.

File.name: 04-SA-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Your plan... was for me to tell Sekai that I liked Sawanaga, that I wanted her help hooking us up, right?!
And because Sawanaga's good friends with you, I'm supposed to have her ask you to set up a date with all four of us.
Sekai cheers up and comes back to school, and I get to date Sawanaga. Two birds with one stone... that's what you said.
If you and I just had a nice, friendly chat about it, there'd be no need for me to talk to Sekai at all!
Sheesh. Not that I'd even want to PRETEND to be friendly with you.
I'm not going through this painful process because I like it, either...
Sekai said she'd leave the house today.
Well, it doesn't seem like she's recovered yet, so I think it's more that she's forcing herself.
Sekai didn't seem all that eager to talk to you, either...
I guess it might actually be harder for her to talk to you, since you're closer to her than I am.
I was totally begging her, like, 'Pretty please!', so she might even come up and talk to you about it today.
So, that's that. Now, I'm leaving before anyone sees us together.
That doesn't mean much coming from someone who's blackmailing me.
You idiot! If anyone finds out about this, it's going to be so embarrassing!

File.name: 04-SA-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You know a lot of girls, right?

File.name: 04-SA-E01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Right? So, there's something I want to discuss with you.
Yeah, I've got a ticket for this pool in Sakakino Hills.
Aqua Square, right? I hear it's pretty popular, with all sorts of different pools and all.
And check this out... I've got FOUR of them!

File.name: 04-SA-E02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Look, I've got a request for you, so just listen.

File.name: 04-SA-E03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Oh, I was just thinking about something.
You'll be doing plenty of that soon enough.
C'mon, don't say that. Like I said, there's something I want to discuss with you.
Sounds even more like a chore now...
Sure, I'll listen, but I'm not promising to do anything.

File.name: 04-SA-E04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You'll totally be onboard once you hear about it. Now, then.
Aqua Square... that's the pool over in Sakakino Hills, right?
You bet! And I've got no less than FOUR tickets!

File.name: 04-SA-E05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: My sister was going to go with her boyfriend, but he couldn't make it, so she gave them to me.
Wouldn't two have been enough, then?
They wanted to stay in a hotel at Sakakino Hills and play for two full days at the pool.
Two whole days, huh. Your sister's a P.E. teacher, isn't she?
Yeah. Knowing her, she could swim for a week straight, never mind just two days.
Well, they were going to be staying in that hotel, right? Forget the pool, I'd say she'd be busy swimming in bed.
S... she'd never do something like that!
W-well, she would... but I don't want to think about it!
Haah... don't even talk about it. You'll depress me.
You really do have a sister complex, don't you?
It's not a complex! It's called caring about my sister!
Yeah, yeah. So, what are you going to do with those tickets?
Isn't it obvious? You and I are going to go.
...Taisuke. I'm not into that kind of thing.
Why not? Because you can't swim?
I've got no intention of swimming with you in the bed of that hotel your sister cancelled on!
She's already cancelled the hotel reservation!
Well, anyway, about these remaining two tickets...
Leave it to me. I'll go and swap them for money at the station's ticket shop.
Look, anyhow... I want you to find two people who can use these tickets.
I hear what you're saying, but...
Ah! Let me warn you up front. No girls with boyfriends, okay?
You and Saionji can disappear halfway through, and then me and the other girl will... mufufufu!
Seriously? Great! I'm counting on you!
It's just a coincidence... but I guess it came at the right time.
So, you're well enough to come to school again. Have you been okay?
You don't get sick usually, so we've been worried about you.
It's fine. Come on, take a seat. A lot's happened while you've been gone! I'll tell you all about it!
Her good friend Hikari paid her a visit.
Uwah. You should have invited me!
If I did, all the cake I brought would have vanished.
Ehh?! You had cake too? You definitely should have invited me, then. The cake from your place is the best...
Ahaha... well, I'll bring some next time, then.
Come on, Sekai! Sit over here!
First of all, during the festival... ah! You were away for the festival too, weren't you?
Well, during the festival, my boyfriend...
Oh, Makoto! Is that a boxed lunch?
Yeah. I bought it from the convenience store this morning.
Oh, I'm still thinking it over.
The tickets are for this weekend, you know. We've only got one chance, so I'm counting on you.
Well... time to eat, I guess.
Are you having cafeteria food today?
No, my mom made lunch for me.
Let's eat together, then. You've already talked plenty with Kanroji and the others, right?
C'mon, don't go quiet on me. I'll just start eating first if you do.
...Aren't you going to eat with Katsura-san?

File.name: 04-SA-E06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You've been gone from school for so long... a lot's happened while you were away.
Kind of. Right now, we're... not eating together.
It's my own fault... for ignoring your warning.
You told me before, didn't you? Not to try anything perverted on her.
Oh, it wasn't anything as hardcore as what you're imagining.
Well, there's no defending what I did, so I just won't say anything.

File.name: 04-SA-E07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...Sorry. That wasn't something I should have asked, was it?
Well, to cut a long story short, I did something a little indecent, and now she hates me... haha.

File.name: 04-SA-E08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So, are you going to eat?
We were eating together before, right?
Not that we can go out on the roof anymore, though, given the cold and all.
...got some... spare time on your hands.
Seriously, this is only if you're free. Are you free, Makoto?

File.name: 04-SA-E09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Okay, I'm going to say it, then.

File.name: 04-SA-E10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Don't jump to conclusions. I'm free.
I was just thinking for a second. I'm wondering when my little sister's going to be coming over next.
So, you've got a little sister.
My parents are divorced, so she's staying with my dad.
But once a month, she always comes back to our house to play.
'Cute' doesn't begin to describe her. She's so cute that you'd faint just looking at her.
Her name's Itaru, and she's still little, so I can understand why she misses seeing Mom and me.
So, I was thinking about when her next visit will be.
I just remembered. She's coming over tomorrow.
She must live pretty close if she can come over on a weekday, right?
No, she lives pretty far away.
Is she taking the day off from school, then?
Just for this month, it seems.
It's her birthday tomorrow, you see.
I told her I was going to buy her a huge teddy bear as a present. She was so happy that she said she'd come over for sure.
I'm cutting it close in terms of my allowance. After I buy that bear, I'll be living the poor life for a while.
Well, let's leave it at that.
So, if tomorrow's little sister day...
In that case, I'll say it.

File.name: 04-SA-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Want to go out somewhere and have some fun?
It's not like it's a date... well, it is, but it's not... um...
We'll get some friends and go as a group of four...
And I'll bring a friend too.

File.name: 04-SA-F01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I was thinking of asking Hikari.

File.name: 04-SA-F02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah, I'll ask Hikari to... wait, how did you know it was Hikari?
Ah... oh, just a feeling I had.
Well, you two looked pretty tight this morning.
Still... it was just a guess.
It's like... you know everything about me.

File.name: 04-SA-F03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Don't you want to have fun with your friends?
It's not that. I was just spacing out for a second.
Will you bring a friend and come along, then?
Is anyone other than Taisuke coming?
I've got to make sure I can run away in advance if they're a jerk, or they're scary or something.
You two don't get along well, do you...?
That's not true. It's just that Kuroda is always looking for a chance to deliver comebacks to everyone else.

File.name: 04-SA-F04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Just now, Taisuke was saying that he had four tickets to the pool.
Aqua Square at Sakakino Hills. Do you know about it?
Sure. It's the place with all sorts of different pools, right?
Taisuke's sister was going to go with her boyfriend, but he suddenly cancelled, so they're up for grabs now.
Wow... I'm sure Hikari would love that.
He said the tickets expire this weekend.
His sister probably passed them on after giving up on them.
I'm surprised you can tell without asking her...
Well, I'll go and tell Hikari.
Those tickets of Taisuke's were a coincidence, but this should work out perfectly now.
Now that that's settled, I'm feeling a little sleepy.
Maybe it's because I just ate...

File.name: 04-SA-F05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: About that request I made this morning!
Oh, that? Relax, I've already taken care of it.
No, not Saionji. I mean that other girl I asked you to invite.
You can forget about that part after all.
I've already invited a girl to come.
I just happened to... no, maybe we were destined to meet? Anyhow, I was expecting to be turned down, but she said yes.
Hey! What about me and Sekai, then?!
It'll be fine. We've got four tickets, so you can go ahead and ask Saionji. Well, see you later!
You were getting pretty heated just then.

File.name: 04-SA-F06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I guess there's no avoiding it. I'll have to explain...
But still... it'd just be cruel to tell Kuroda the truth...
What are you going all quiet for?

File.name: 04-SA-F07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Oh, no, it was nothing. Just the usual.
The usual stupid talk, you mean? Can't believe you don't get sick of it.

File.name: 04-SA-F08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What are you going all quiet for? She asked you a question!
Uuh... I feel like a kid being bullied for his money.
Oh, never mind that. Did something happen?
Still, if Taisuke's managed to score with a girl, then I've got no need for Kuroda anymore.
...Of course, she'd totally kill me if I said that.
After all, I was the one who suggested this plan...

File.name: 04-SA-F09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I need to tell you something.
Ah! What do you think you're doing, only telling Sekai?!
Listen, we've got a little problem.
It's Taisuke... it seems he went and invited another girl at lunchtime, and she said 'yes'.
Yeah. Sawanaga's not a bad guy...
but he's not the type who can just hit on a random girl and expect her to say yes.
No need to be so obtuse. You can just come out and say it: he's not popular.
Anyhow... now that mystery girl's coming to the pool, and we've only got four tickets.
But the whole point of this is to get Hikari and Taisuke to go on a date.
If that's the case, having another girl come along would be a problem.

File.name: 04-SA-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's Sawanaga from class 3... do you remember me?
It's been a while since I last saw you, so I was feeling kind of nostalgic.
Do you always eat here at the cafeteria?
I do, but I don't see you here often.
Competition's pretty fierce here, isn't it?
Oh, no. I buy it from a nearby shop in the morning...
The thing is, I've got these spare tickets for the pool, and I was wondering... whether you'd like to go.
You know that pool in Sakakino Hills called Aqua Square? That's what the tickets are for, so why don't we go together?
O-of course, it won't just be the two of us, it's not like that. Your friends will be going, too.
You mentioned that you know Makoto and Saionji, right?
They're coming, too. So, how about it?
Yeah. It'll just be people you know, so you can rest easy.
It's next week, so I'll see you then.

File.name: 04-SA-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hikari said she can go to the pool, too.
Yeah, you mentioned that at lunchtime, didn't you?
I hadn't checked with her then.
The pool... that means swimsuits, right...?
Don't worry, you've got a great figure.
That only sounds like an insult coming from you!
Oh, calm down. Ah, I know! Why don't we go and buy swimsuits?
It's the off season, so I'm sure there'll be some cheap ones.
I get the feeling it's the other way around... but I'd still like to go.
Maybe we should get some really daring ones.
Fufu... well, see you tomorrow, Makoto.

File.name: 04-SA-H01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It'll be fine. Things can still go on even if I'm not there, but you and Kuroda are essential, right?
There's no need for me to go, either.
If Kuroda runs into trouble, you're the only one who can help her.
Well... it's true that you two don't really get along.
It's more like we don't get along at all.
In exchange, just let me know the results.
Whether things go well for Taisuke and Kuroda.
Your role will be to keep Taisuke and that other girl apart, okay?

File.name: 04-SA-H02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: All we've got to do is buy another ticket.
Come to think of it, you're right.
I'll steer Taisuke towards Kuroda, so your job will be to keep him and that other girl apart.

File.name: 04-SA-H03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Leave it to me. I've got a great plan.
You'll just have to wait and see.
Think you'll be able to start coming to school tomorrow?
Well, given what's happening with Hikari, I can't very well take the day off.

File.name: 04-SA-H04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Why? You want to have lunch together?
Kotonoha asked whether you, Taisuke and the others wanted to eat together.
It's not that I won't, but...
Taisuke would probably agree. Is it Kuroda who's the problem?
No... but it seems that last night, Hikari called Sawanaga.
At first, she was just making small talk about how excited she was about the pool,
but eventually, they started hitting it off, and then they arranged to meet up for lunch. She was rejoicing about it.

File.name: 04-SA-H05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Why? You want to have lunch together?
Well... Katsura-san came by just now and asked if Sawanaga, Hikari and the others wanted to have lunch together.
Actually... it seems Hikari and Sawanaga have suddenly gotten really close. They're already eating lunch together.

File.name: 04-SA-H06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Uwah... Kuroda would kill us if we interrupted them.
I guess there's no helping it. Let's eat with just the three of us, just like before.

File.name: 04-SA-I01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I guess I'll talk it over with Sekai.

File.name: 04-SA-I02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll just say I'm not feeling well on the day, and that I can't go.
Taisuke's got the tickets, after all, and it'll be just the right number of people.
He's going to be in paradise.

File.name: 04-SA-I03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I guess thinking it over isn't going to help.
There's no need for me to go. I'll have achieved my goal as long as Sekai cheers up.

File.name: 04-SA-I04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah, it's a bear. Just what you wanted, right?
Um... Itaru is going to treat it like it was onii-cha and take good care of it.
That's supposed to be me, huh?

File.name: 04-SA-I05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hold on for a second, Itaru.
I'm sorry for calling you so late. Were you asleep?
It's not bedtime yet... I was just relaxing in my room.

File.name: 04-SA-I06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So, what were we talking about?
Ah! That's right! Hey, hey, hey! Onii-cha!
Can I take a bath with him?
We'll be bathing and sleeping together!
Well, you can sleep with him, but bathing's no good. It'd be a problem if he got wet.
I'll take a bath with you instead. How's that sound?
Onii-cha and the bear should come in together...
That wouldn't work... hey, once you go home, that bear's going to be my replacement, right?
In that case, why don't I be his replacement for bathtime?
Then... then Itaru will be the hunter! Bang!
Okay, time for the bear to strike back! Come on, off to the bathroom!
Okay! Wait up, Mr. Bear! Kyaaafuu!

File.name: 04-SA-I07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: U-um! About the pool event this weekend!
Oh, so the girl he invited was you...?
Yes, because he said that you'd be coming.
Sorry... but I don't think I'll be going.
Actually, I've already invited two others, but Taisuke said he only had four tickets.
You mean you can't go because you don't have a ticket?
Yeah. Besides, I was only in it to set Taisuke up with a girl he was interested in.
Aqua Square is in Sakakino Hills, right?
It should be okay. I think I can get a ticket through my father's connections.
My father works at a property firm there.
If it's for this weekend, I think it's still possible if I ask him now... it should be fine.
We haven't talked in such a long time. I've missed you...
I'll be looking forward to this weekend.

File.name: 04-SA-I08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Are you busy at the moment?
Wah! Stop that, you idiot. S-sorry, can this wait?

File.name: 04-SA-I09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Over by the window... it was all flappy.
It wasn't just the laundry! There was a ghost, too!
I guess there's no helping it... tell you what, I'll sleep together with you.
Yeah. That should make things okay, right?
Okay. I'll just pick a childish-looking book at random, then... okay, this'll do.
Uh... 'There sat Shanghai in the pre-dawn hours, buried beneath a thick, yellow fog that hung in the air like pea soup.'
'I had firmly shut each of the thick shutters in the house and sealed the remaining gaps with tape.'
'But still the fog came rolling in, appearing out of nowhere to render the light in the corridor a damp, dream-like blur.'
'The raw smell unique to the fog of Shanghai had already permeated the room!'
'"Oh, Green 18, our vice-leader!" The leader removed his mask and cradled the madam's body.'
'As expected, it was Ambassador Di Schuler. The body of Madam Lau was still warm.'
'But by the time the leader turned to seek me out,'
'I was already on a plane with Comrade Lin Tien, high above the skies of Shanghai.'
This is actually pretty interesting, but maybe it's too mature for Itaru.

File.name: 04-SA-J00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I've got to buy a birthday present for Itaru.
Let's see, I've got... geh, only 2,000 yen left, huh.
I wonder how much a pool ticket costs.
It'd be no joke if I didn't have enough left...

File.name: 04-SA-J01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I guess I'll go and check.
Let's see... I think the ticket shop at the station should...
A student ticket to Aqua Square is 3,200 yen...
It's even worse when I consider the costs of the train fare and food and drink.
But seeing as how I don't have a part-time job, it's not like I have any spare money...
Haah... I'll just pretend to be sick.
Better than looking like an idiot.

File.name: 04-SA-J02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Still... I guess I should manage. It's just the pool, after all.
I can't wait to see Itaru's face light up...

File.name: 04-SA-K00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You said you were in your room... liar.

File.name: 04-SA-L00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So, you were the girl that Taisuke invited.
Yes, he mentioned that both you and Makoto-kun were coming...

File.name: 04-SA-L01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I got a call this morning. Seems like he's not feeling well.
Well, let's go and enjoy his share of the fun, too!

File.name: 04-SA-L02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ahh... he said he wasn't feeling well today, so he's just going to sleep.
There's no helping that guy, is there? He's like a kid who gets a fever the day before the school trip.
I wonder if he's all right...?
No need to worry, Katsura-san. It's just Makoto.

File.name: 04-SA-L03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's okay. She's an acquaintance of mine, so I'll just tell her to stay away from Taisuke and keep talking to me.
Things might be different if it was a stranger, but since I know her, I should be able to get her to agree.
But... isn't she interested in Sawanaga? After all, she did agree to come to the pool with him.
That's totally out of the question.
Come on! Should we start with the wave pool? The water slide? Or maybe we could try the sauna like sophisticated gents...
I'd like to try the water slide!
Can we talk for a moment?
I've got to talk to Katsura-san about something. Do you and Hikari mind going on ahead?
Aww... okay, but hurry up and come.
Um... did you want to talk to me about something?
That was my friend Hikari just now. She likes Sawanaga, so I brought her along.
I see... then we mustn't disturb them.
We got to know each other during the festival.
Well... you accepted his invitation to come to the pool, so I was wondering whether you liked him.
That's not it at all... the one that I love is Makoto-kun.
Since we're here anyway, would you mind if I talked to you about that?
Sure. We've got plenty of time.
...And so, while I was busy being afraid, Makoto-kun and I were growing more and more distant...
Could it be... that Makoto-kun likes that class representative girl from class 3?
After all, he might hate me now...
Setsuna would be the last person he'd fall in love with.
But they seemed very close during the festival.
I invited him to come and see the festival, but he turned me down... and spent the whole time with her instead...
There's no way that could be true. Setsuna and I have been friends since we were born, so I would know.

File.name: 04-SA-L04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Does this have something to do with the rep from class 4?
It seems there's something happening between her and Itou.
That's not the reason you're feeling down, then?
Did she do it for my sake...?

File.name: 04-SA-L05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You're thinking too hard about it.
Besides, Setsuna transferred out last week, so even if she did like Makoto, there's nothing she can do about it now.
No! If Makoto-kun loved her too, I think the two of them would continue to feel the same way.
Oh, sheesh. You really do think too much.

File.name: 04-SA-L06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I've hurt him... so maybe he doesn't like me anymore... when I think about that, it makes me so anxious...
And I can't even call him anymore... I tried e-mailing him once, but he didn't reply.
And now that it's cold, we don't have lunch on the roof anymore...
but we haven't made plans to eat elsewhere, either, so we've stopped altogether...
Am I... really still his girlfriend?
I was planning on meeting him, making up and having lots of fun today...
But he couldn't make it, huh?

File.name: 04-SA-L07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sorry! I took a bit too long getting ready.
...Sorry. My sister insisted on tagging along... ah, but it's okay. My parents are paying for her ticket.
What are you, stupid?! She's my sister!
...I told her I didn't have the money to buy her a birthday present,
but when my mom dug out my swimming trunks, she told her about the pool.
And so, she decided to come with you?
As a substitute for a birthday present.
Ahahah... be sure to give her some good memories, then.
Itaru-chan's running all by herself towards the kids' pool... is that really okay?
Oh, right! Well, I'll be going to the kids' pool too, then.
Okay, how about we head for the water slide?
That sounds nice. I love the water slide.
All right! Let's go for that!
Can we talk for a moment?
I've got to talk to Katsura-san about something. Do you and Hikari mind going on ahead?
Aww... okay, but hurry up and come.
Um... did you want to talk to me about something?
That was my friend Hikari just now. She likes Sawanaga, so I brought her along.
I see... then we mustn't disturb them.
We got to know each other during the festival.
Well... you accepted his invitation to come to the pool, so I was wondering whether you liked him.
That's not it at all... the one that I love is Makoto-kun.
Since we're here anyway, would you mind if I talked to you about that?
Sure. We've got plenty of time.
...And so, while I was busy being afraid, Makoto-kun and I were growing more and more distant...
Could it be... that Makoto-kun likes that class representative girl from class 3?
After all, he might hate me now...
Setsuna would be the last person he'd fall in love with.
But they seemed very close during the festival.
I invited him to come and see the festival, but he turned me down... and spent the whole time with her instead...
There's no way that could be true. Setsuna and I have been friends since we were born, so I would know.

File.name: 04-SA-L08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Does this have something to do with the rep from class 4?
It seems there's something happening between her and Itou.
That's not the reason you're feeling down, then?
Did she do it for my sake...?

File.name: 04-SA-L09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You're thinking too hard about it.
Besides, Setsuna transferred out last week, so even if she did like Makoto, there's nothing she can do about it now.
No! If Makoto-kun loved her too, I think the two of them would continue to feel the same way.
Oh, sheesh. You really do think too much.

File.name: 04-SA-L10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Now that it's cold, we don't have lunch on the roof anymore...
But we haven't made plans to eat elsewhere, either, so we've stopped altogether...
Am I... really still his girlfriend?
Yes, you're right... after all, he did come to the pool today.
Not that anyone was expecting him to bring his sister, though.
She certainly is cute, isn't she?
Shall we go and play with her too?

File.name: 04-SA-M01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Not at all, we had fun playing with Itaru-chan.
Thanks... hearing that makes me feel a bit better.
Well, we'll be taking the train.
Uh-huh. We'll be going home by bus.

File.name: 04-SA-M02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: How'd you do being all alone with Sawanaga?
...Does Katsura-san have someone that she likes?
Are you sure she doesn't like him?
Well, I mean... she's got a boyfriend.
I see... so it's just Sawanaga who feels that way.
That's right. You need to relax.
In that case... you go and tell him.
Well, I mean... he and I aren't all that close either, you know? It'd be weird if I just suddenly told him that, right?
I wonder if Sawanaga like that type of girl...
Cute, with long hair... and big breasts, too. If I were a boy, I'd definitely go for that kind of girl.

File.name: 04-SA-M03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: True. Let's all come again sometime.

File.name: 04-SA-M04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: No! It was my fault... for saying something like that.
Well, that's that. Let's split up here for today!

File.name: 04-SA-M05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: There was an odd mood between them, wasn't there?
It seems things are going well.

File.name: 04-SA-N00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sorry! I took a little longer than I should have.
I had some trouble getting out of the house.
Well... my little sister came over and said she wanted to play.
You could have just brought her with you.
Well, it seems she snuck out from my dad's place without permission... so I took her back.
I see. You live with your mom, right?
It was her birthday this week, so we had a party. She was so happy that she started talking about moving in with us...
Don't worry about it. Let's go.
Sekai said she couldn't come because she had something urgent to attend to.
I just tried calling her after hearing that she was coming.
Well, we've only got four tickets anyway, so that suits us just fine.
Leave it to me. I've got a great plan.

File.name: 04-SA-N01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: S-sorry! I just remembered something urgent too!
Ehh? But you just got here.
Yeah, but this is something really important.
Just forget about it. You're already here at the pool.
I can't. I have to take care of this, no matter what...
What is this thing you have to take care of, anyway?
It's... o-oh, yeah. Something my mom told me to do!
It's family business, so I can't tell you the details... b-but anyhow, I'm sorry! So... see you later!
Family business, huh... must be his sister, I guess.
...What am I supposed to do with both of them gone?

File.name: 04-SA-N02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sheesh... what great plan...? She's just leaving me stuck with...

File.name: 04-SA-N03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What are you spacing out for?
Sekai's not here, so you'd better do something.
That girl... she's Katsura-san from class 4, right?
I wonder... if she and Sawanaga get along well?
Normal... as in a normal couple?
She's giving off these vibes of kindness whenever she looks at Sawanaga.
Look, just leave things to me.
Nn... you don't seem too reliable.
I-I was just kidding! If you go home now, it'll just be me and those two!
Please! You don't have to pull them apart or help me or anything! Just stay with me!
Kotonoha's not exactly going to eat him...
Sawanaga seems like he'd go for that type of girl... I feel like I want to die just being next to her.
If you told him that to his face, I think he'd start paying attention to you.
A-as if I could say something so embarrassing!
Hey! What are you guys doing? We're going in!

File.name: 04-SA-N04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Not if you don't want me to.
Well, what if I wanted you to touch me...? Would you want to?
I don't know... maybe I would.

File.name: 04-SA-N05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Of course I do. I'm a guy.

File.name: 04-SA-N06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Y-yes, it's not easy to answer, is it...? A question like that...
I think I'd be troubled, too, if I were asked, 'Do you want to?'
The truth is, I'd be even more bothered if I were actually touched.
Because of that, I've caused you trouble before...
But... the truth is, I do want to be brave and respond... I'm sorry, I don't know what I'm saying.

File.name: 04-SA-N07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yes...! No! I... I wanted to apologize. Yes. That's right.

File.name: 04-SA-N08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You want me to touch you, right?

File.name: 04-SA-N10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: A pool with moving water, a water slide... there are all sorts of pools here, aren't there?
All right! Where shall we begin?
I'd like to try the water slide.
I need to talk to Kotonoha about something.
Do you mind going ahead with Kuroda? We'll catch up with you later.
Uh... well, all sorts of things, but that too.
I see. Well, we'll take it slow, so catch up with us later.
Kuroda... oh, I mean, that girl. Her name's Kuroda.
Sawanaga-san introduced us earlier. They're from the same junior high school, aren't they?
Yeah, and all this time, she's had her eyes on him... that's why I want to give her my support.
I don't want to get in the way, so let's just chill somewhere. If we just wander around, we might actually run into them.
Okay, let's take it easy by the poolside, then.
I'm glad... that you gave us the chance to talk alone like this.
Ever since the festival... I've been so anxious, wondering whether you were avoiding me.
I was sure that... I'd hurt you...
That's why... it makes me so happy...
Do you... want to do it?
Do you want to... touch me... and do indecent things to me...?

SetSELECT.sel1: 'Not if you don't want me to'

File.name: 04-SA-O00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...Don't let her bother you too much.

File.name: 04-SA-O01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She looks a lot like you.

File.name: 04-SA-O02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll bet it's because you have such a cheerful and fun mom that you turned out to be such a great person.
What do you mean, great person?
You're cheerful and fun... and you want everyone else to be happy, but when it comes to yourself, you hesitate.

File.name: 04-SA-O03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry. My mom's... well, sociable. She'll drag anyone she can out for tea and a chat.
It's okay, you don't have to cover for her.
Really, it was fun... although I was kind of nervous.
Well, she's your mom. Of course I'd be nervous.

File.name: 04-SA-O04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Don't lie. You're perfectly fine right now.
...It was because you didn't have a ticket, wasn't it?
There's no need for me to be there.
No, there isn't. It's supposed to be a date between Sawanaga and Hikari.
And besides... you and Katsura-san are going out, so you've got to be together.

File.name: 04-SA-O05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It'd be awkward with just me and her.
So come on, come with us.
I feel calmer when you're around.

File.name: 04-SA-O06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Things got awkward just before the festival... and ever since then.
I can't manage without you, Sekai.

File.name: 04-SA-O07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry. I'm acting all selfish, and I'm not even making any sense.
The truth is, if I didn't want to worry you, I could have just gone to the pool pretending not to know anything,
supported Hikari and stayed away from you two.
But I didn't want to see you two getting along so well...
No, I should be the one apologizing.
Ahaha... miserable, isn't it? This is why I shut myself away in here, and yet my mom goes and ruins it. Sheesh!
Why don't you come in? You haven't even touched your tea, have you?

File.name: 04-SA-O08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haah... I'll be counting on you next time.
Next time...? Aren't you going back?
Going back now would be a bit... you know. I'm going home.
Want to come in for some tea, then?

File.name: 04-SA-O09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll make sure Mom keeps quiet.
You don't really need to do that.
If I don't, she'll start saying funny things.
Haha... well, I'll be coming in for a while, then.

File.name: 04-SA-O10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's been fun. Your mom's such a funny person.

File.name: 04-SA-P00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Up to the ticket gates would have been fine.
I've got a rail pass, so I can see you off at the platform too.
Let's see... ah, there's an express coming.
It's not stopping here, is it?
...will be after the express passes through, huh. Looks like we'll have to wait for a bit. Brr, it sure is cold.
...Well, it IS the end of autumn.

File.name: 04-SA-Q00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What the heck is he doing...?
Sorry! I took a little longer than I should have.
I had some trouble getting out of the house.
Well... my little sister came over and said she wanted to play.
You could have just brought her with you.
Well, it seems she snuck out from my dad's place without permission... so I took her back.
I see. You live with your mom, right?
It was her birthday this week, so we had a party. She was so happy that she started talking about moving in with us...
Don't worry about it. Let's go.

File.name: 04-SA-Q01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Itou's the only one with a separate ticket?
Ah... well, you know how we had one more person than expected coming, right?
My father has some connections here, so he got us an extra ticket.

File.name: 04-SA-Q02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah... we don't have enough tickets.
I thought this might happen, so I got an extra ticket from my father.
Yes. My father has some connections here, so he managed to get an extra ticket.

File.name: 04-SA-Q03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Gwah... if I'd known it was so convenient,
I wouldn't have had to bow down, cook, scrub the toilet, do the laundry and clean the bath for my sister to get them...
I wanted to go to the pool.
Yes, yes, we all recognize your efforts.
A pool with moving water, a water slide... there are all sorts of pools here, aren't there?
All right! Where shall we begin?
I'd like to try the water slide.
We're going over to the poolside for a while, so you go on ahead.
Well, you and Saionji can come later, then. We'll go on ahead.
I thought Katsura-san was quieter than that.
Seems like she really likes the pool, huh?
Let's relax here while we wish Kuroda good luck.
They're sure taking their time, aren't they?

File.name: 04-SA-R00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: We're arrived. This is your stop.

File.name: 04-SA-S00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eheheh... I've been looking for you.
Have you been waiting for me?
Just a little. I didn't know when you were coming, so... actually, I only thought of it last night.
Well... if you're busy, then it can wait...
It's been a while, but would you like to have lunch together again?
Not just the two of us... but with everyone from yesterday, too.
Eheheh, that's wonderful. I've brought a big water bottle so that there's enough for everyone.
Yes, and it's warm... although the weather is unusually warm today.
It's been freezing lately, hasn't it?
But since it's warm, it'll be easier for us to eat on the roof.

File.name: 04-SA-T00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Taisuke and Kuroda already made plans to meet for lunch... would you mind if it was just the three of us?
Ah... well, if that's the case...
That's all right. I've always thought Sawanaga-san and Kuroda-san would make a nice couple.
Well, let's head for the roof.
Yeah. It's warm today, so the roof should be nice.
Class representatives, please come to the student council room during lunch to pick up handouts for your class.
I'll hold the water bottle, so just finish up quickly and come back.
Would have been nice if she had given us the bread, too.
Well, she was in a hurry, right? After all, it's the first time the three of us have eaten together in a while.

File.name: 04-SA-U00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You can start eating if you're hungry.
No, I'm not hungry... just a bit sleepy.
I have, but after the pool, I spent some more time playing with my sister, so I didn't get any rest at all Saturday...
In that case, you can sleep until Katsura-san arrives. I'll wake you when she's here.
Really? Well, maybe I'll do that, then.
Come on, put your head down here.
You can't sleep if you're nervous.
Whenever... I'm with you... I really do... feel relaxed...

File.name: 04-SB-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Oh, right. Taisuke said that he's coming.
He said there was someone he wanted me to meet during lunchtime, so I told him to bring them here.
I wish you wouldn't bring other people here.
but I didn't want to waste lunchtime with Taisuke. Knowing him, there's no telling how long I'd have to wait.
I'll trade you for some of my lunchbox, then.
Yep. So before she left for school in the morning, I made her lunch and made some for myself while I was at it.
That's incredible! Look, you've even got laid-out seaweed and beautifully-wrapped fried eggs. It's like the real thing!
It IS the real thing, but everything except the eggs is frozen food.
Okay, then. I'll take that fried egg!
No way! This is the first time you've brought a lunchbox, isn't it? This isn't something an amateur could make!
I live alone with my mom. Of course I can make my own lunch... I just don't bother most of the time.
Uuu... no way. Don't eat mine.
I can't let someone who makes such nice lunches have any.
What are you talking about? Let me have some.
What are you guys doing, making out like that?
T-Taisuke... how long have you been there?
So, about the person I wanted you to meet.
The truth is, I've got a girlfriend now, too!
Hmm... well, I know one girl who likes Sawanaga.
It seems you and Saionji know her, too... so I wanted you guys to be the first to know.

File.name: 04-SB-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...Still, this is a surprise. Since when have you and Sawanaga been going out?
I see... this is sure unexpected. Right, Makoto?
So, you found a girlfriend during the festival. Nice work!
How did you ask her out?
Well... let's just call it a victory for effort.
That doesn't make any sense at all.

File.name: 04-SB-B01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I guess it was because I was so insistent.
Well, anyhow, we'll keep the details to ourselves! Uwahaha!
Or has Taisuke done something to hurt her...?
No, I guess I'm the one who's hurt her the most...
If I'd just done what she wanted of me at the festival, she never would have chosen Taisuke...

File.name: 04-SB-B02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: After the festival... at sunset, she was crying by herself in front of class 4.
When I asked her what happened, it turned out that her terrible boyfriend had stood her up, so I danced with her instead.
Actually, she'd already turned me down earlier, so I was so happy that I could die!
So, anyhow, we're going out together now.
You ought to be grateful to that terrible boyfriend of hers, then.
On one hand, I think he's a bastard for making her cry, but on the other, he's the great guy who brought us together...
Well, I guess my first task is to make Katsura-san forget all about him.
Yep, that's right! Give it your best!
It was all because... I left Kotonoha and went to the bonfire with Sekai...

File.name: 04-SB-B03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, guess it's time to go home...
Want to stop by somewhere on the way home?
Do you have something going on?
Hikari... I mean, the girls are hanging out together.
I see. Well, I'll leave first, then.

File.name: 04-SB-B04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah! My life's just, like, peachy!
You're getting way too worked up...
Today, at lunchtime, we're going to... mwahaha!
Hey, Makoto, why don't we have lun... ah!

File.name: 04-SB-B05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I thought we could have lunch together.
Ah... I see. I'll go and buy something quickly, then.
Of course. It's revenge for yesterday.
Yep! I've been undergoing special training to top yesterday's food!
Wow... it wasn't anything special, you know.
No! It was frustrating for me!
Okay, okay... thanks for the food, then.
Ooh, you say that about everything you eat.
No... somehow, I can tell it's different from your usual food.
You see? The truth is, I've secretly been training with Setsuna's mom.
What does Kioura's mom do for a living?
The same as my mom. They work at a family restaurant company called 'Radish'.
Setsuna's mom works in product development, researching things like food.
She's, like, a total pro. A pro!
...So, you made this all by yourself?
Building the sandwiches, setting the salad dressing... and most of the fried stuff.
That's pretty much all of it.
Uuh... but it tasted good, right?
Yeah, it was great. I'll be looking forward to tomorrow.
Tomorrow's when you'll be doing it yourself with the skills you learned from Kioura's mom, right?
Don't try to gloss over it by laughing, either.
Well, okay, I'm just joking... it really was delicious.
You seemed kind of down when you went home yesterday... I felt kind of bad about not being able to go with you.
But you're still looking a little depressed even now.
I don't know what it is you're worried about, but if you want to talk about it, I'm willing to listen anytime.
I just got an e-mail saying that my mom's leaving for Paris on a business trip today.
It seems she's coming back on Sunday night... if you like, why don't you come over?
Eheheh... I've been so busy since before the festival that we haven't been able to hang out together.
If I don't do anything for too long... you might start going after other girls.
Setsuna's coming over to stay tonight.
The three of us could sleep over together.
No thanks, I'd feel all chained up. I'll pass.
Sekai, let's go to Pure Burger again today!
Hikari, Setsuna, you're good to come too, right?
So... you're choosing to skip training and get dirty looks from the seniors.
It's fine. I don't feel like going today.
Hikari's got to come. It's the second day of our strategic meeting for her sake.
Sorry... I've got something going on.
I guess it can't be helped, then...
Let's just go with the three of us, even if Hikari can't come.
What about the plan to support Hikari?
Why don't we try working out the things we can do on our own?
Ah, Setsuna. Do you have any good ideas?
We'll get Nanami's boyfriend to show her his games.
What are those? The kind you play on a computer?
N-no! Senpai said he was going to concentrate on playing them today.
Haah... this is Nanami's friend, Kioura.
How is it that you know senpai's phone number?!
Yes. Nanami said that the game you were playing was really great... yes, she was quite happy.
Ah... yes. So... she's with us right now, and we all wanted to see, too...
Is that okay? Yes. The place... yes. We're with Nanami, so I'm sure we can work it out. Yes. Well, see you soon.
Kasannoin-senpai seems like a surprisingly nice guy.
How do you know senpai's phone number?!
I copied the address book from your phone the other day.
During the festival, when you skipped your shift to go on a date with senpai, you forgot your phone.
...Come to think of it, you got really mad when you called Nanami, only to hear her ringtone coming from the bags.
I'm glad it came in handy so soon.
Oh, come on... don't be sad, Nanami.
Off to senpai's house we go.

File.name: 04-SB-C01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Looks like you two were having a disagreement.
Nah, we were just talking. Right, Katsura-san?
Hahaha... you're still just a brat, so you wouldn't understand a real adult relationship.
Come on... we're boyfriend and girlfriend.
You only announced you were getting together at lunch, and you're splitting up already? That was quick.
That's not what I mean! Our trains go in opposite directions, so we have to split up here.
Come on, say, 'See you tomorrow,' and give me one on the cheek.

File.name: 04-SB-C03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Shouldn't it be on the lips?
Oh! That's true. Good one, Makoto.
Come on, give me one right here.
H-haha... maybe it's still a bit too soon?
W-well, the train's here. See you tomorrow, Katsura-san.

File.name: 04-SB-C04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Can't you see that you're troubling Kotonoha?
Um... actually, this is a little...
Ahahahah... r-right. No, of course. People are watching, after all.
Anyhow! Maybe next time, when we're all alone and no one's watching...

File.name: 04-SB-C05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Thanks, Katsura-san! Well, see you tomorrow!

File.name: 04-SB-C06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I... was surprised to hear that you and Taisuke are going out.
I mean, he's an idiot... but he's not a bad guy. S-so, what is it you like about him?

File.name: 04-SB-C07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: My class... thought that Sawanaga-san and I were going out. I tried to talk to him to resolve the misunderstanding...
And then he forced me to go out with him, saying that you were already going out with Saionji-san...
