There's a girl who's liked him ever since the entrance ceremony. She was going out with him long before you met him.
She's usually such a cheerful girl, but she's shy. And when it's time to make the play, she freezes. That's why I'm here.
You're here at her request, then?
Of course not. She's the type of girl who'd say, 'It's too bad. I'll let her have him,' when thieves like you come along.
But I won't let that happen.
...Who is she? This girl who thinks she's going out with Makoto-kun.
I told you, she doesn't 'think' she's going out with him. She IS going out with him!
...What are you going to do if I tell you?
I'm going to ask her to give up.
...If Makoto-kun has caused that girl to misunderstand, the least I can do is apologize to her, too.
...You really are hopeless, aren't you? You annoyed me even in junior high, but I never imagined you were this bad.
I never imagined you'd invent an imaginary girlfriend to get between me and Makoto-kun, either.
If you want to know that badly, I'll tell you.
You saw her at lunchtime, didn't you? The girl sitting next to Itou.
That's a lie... Saionji-san was the one who was telling me to go out with Makoto-kun...
There's no way she'd say that.
Knowing Sekai... maybe she went all weak after hearing that you liked Itou and decided to let you have him...
That's not true... Saionji-san isn't going out with him...
It is. Her other friends and I all know that she likes Itou.
You're wrong... this is a misunderstanding...
I'm telling you, it's not! Listen! Sekai even stays over at his house all the time!
Do you know what it means when a boy and a girl spend the night together?!
They're practically living together. What sort of misunderstanding could there be?
But... every night, he e-mails me to say 'good night'...
You've been warned. Next time you get close to him, I won't go easy on you.

File.name: 04-SC-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What did you want to talk about?
I guess I didn't need to make lunch after all, huh? Haha.
I remembered afterwards, and I thought about telling you, but you just seemed so happy that I missed my chance...
I really did want to try your lunch, but...
I brought that lunch for myself. I just made a bit too much, that's all.
I was thinking of sharing some with you, though...
Make sure you do, next time.
I've... been thinking... am I just going to keep being the girl you sleep with while we hide this from Katsura-san...?
I don't want that. It makes me feel guilty.
At first, I was happy just to sleep with you...
and lately, the sex has felt pretty good, too. I want to sleep with you because I love you, but...
This... isn't right, is it? After all, I'm just a substitute because Katsura-san won't do it with you, aren't I...?
No, I'm not! If I am, then have lunch with me!
I've been doing something terrible to you, haven't I...? I'm sorry.
I'm sorry, okay? Maybe I've just been a little irritated from this lack of sleep.
That wasn't what I wanted to say. The truth is... yeah. I think... I really wanted to do it, too.
Yeah! Come on, we'll pick up where we left off!
Just forget about what I said... come on, let's go...

File.name: 04-SC-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: We should have just stayed good friends.
I don't want to just be friends...
...Let's go back to being good friends, okay?

File.name: 04-SC-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm... going to be honest. I'm going to be more truthful to myself.
I... think I might be in love with you...
Uh-huh... more than you love Katsura-san...?

File.name: 04-SC-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haah... I was late for the meeting.
That's what I wanted to talk about... you'll come, won't you?

File.name: 04-SC-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She's lying... Kanroji-san's been a bully since junior high school. She's just trying to hurt me with these lies...
I'll bet she saw me speaking with Saionji-san at lunchtime and just came up with something on the spot.
There's no way that Makoto-kun would be 'practically living together' with Saionji-san... even I've only kissed him once...
No. Makoto-kun isn't that kind of person! Makoto-kun has always been a gentleman. He'd never do something as indecent as...
Makoto... hey... together... you're about to come too... right?!
It's okay...! Come...! All... inside me...!
Nnah... I... I'm... c-com... coming...! Ahah... ah... haah... aaaaah!

File.name: 04-SE-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I just can't... keep silent about how I really feel anymore.
How I really feel... and the person that I really love.

File.name: 04-SE-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sheesh... what kind of guy goes and hits on someone's girlfriend right in front of them?
I've been traumatized, you know. I might be dead by tomorrow.
H-hey! Cut it out with the bad jokes.
Ahh... there's no point in living, now that I've been dumped by my beloved girlfriend...
Still, I guess there's no point in being all depressed.
Well, I mean, you guys were going out in the first place, right?
Really? Everyone including me thought you and Saionji were an item.
To be honest, that's why I was like, 'Finally, he's here,' when you arrived.
Even when we were going out, she always had her mind on something else, and she'd always be looking at you.
It was obvious that she liked you.
Keh! Don't get all embarrassed on me.
Anyhow, from now on, I'll just be sticking with my sister.
You were the one who made me lose it!
You ought to introduce me to someone.
What I'm saying is, if Saionji has any cute friends, introduce them to me.
Sekai's friends, huh. Kanroji... has a boyfriend, I think. Kioura... well, she's a bit short. Apart from them... oh.
Hmm? Have you thought of someone?
Why not? Don't you like her? She's one of the cuter girls in our class, right?
Really? I spent three years in the same class as her, so whether she's cute or not... I can't really tell anymore.
Just like a married couple, huh...?
Well, anyhow, I'll let her know.
What? She might say yes, you know.
Sheesh... you'd better not be underestimating a broken heart.
Yeah, yeah... by the way, it's already past two. Are you sure you don't need to sleep?
Shut up! I'm not sleeping until you promise to introduce me to a cute girl!

File.name: 04-SE-B01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I wonder... if she'll hold this against Sekai.
If she does... I wish she'd just hate me instead.
I've done more than enough to deserve it...

File.name: 04-SE-B02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haah... that Sekai... I wonder if she went to sleep?
I guess she'd be tired after that conversation with Kotonoha...
Ahh... I've got nothing to do...

File.name: 04-SE-B03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Maybe I'll just try calling her.
Now connecting you to voicemail. This phone is...

File.name: 04-SE-B04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Come to think of it, I told Katou that I'd call her.
I told you that I'd call you, right?
The truth is, I only called because I had nothing else to do. So if you've got something to take care of, go ahead.

File.name: 04-SE-B05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah. It's not every day that I get a call from you. What's up?
Eh...?! Oh, nothing in particular... but you said you'd call me, didn't you?
Come to think of it, I did.
So I was kind of thinking that it'd be okay for me to call you, too.
Ah! It's fine, if I'm bothering you. I just had nothing better to do than to call you.
No, I'm bored out of my mind, too.
Haha, you called at just the right time.

File.name: 04-SE-B06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So, have you heard about Arima-sensei?
Have you been keeping in touch with the guys from junior high?
I thought so. Ii was complaining about how hard it was to get a hold of you.
That suits me just fine, when it comes to Ii.
Ahahah... what about this, then? Have you heard that Ikeda and Reizei are going out now?
Seriously?! Uwah... I'm really losing touch with the world...
Let's all get together some time at that beach near your house. That place where we used to hang out all the time.
Yeah. For the first time in ages, I feel like seeing all of them again.

File.name: 04-SE-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You didn't get enough sleep either, huh?
Well, we did talk until dawn...
Seems like we'll be able to sleep well during today's classes...
It's another nice day today, isn't it? Even if it is a little cold.
You'll have lunch with me today... won't you?
Did you buy some bread or something to bring today?
No, I overslept, so I was just thinking of buying something from the cafeteria.
Why don't we eat in the classroom, then?
After all, now we can meet without being worried about being seen...
What are you getting all excited about? Is everything feeling new and thrilling now that you've started going out? Huh?
Uh... no, it does feel exciting, but...
What are you getting all sappy about so early in the morning?!
Well, given how much of a show you're putting on... morning.
He loves her more than anyone... morning.
Cut it out with those terrible greetings!
Aww, calm down. Why not tell big sis all about it?
About you and Sekai, of course.
Oh, what's this? Just look at what your husband's saying, Sekai-san.
Ugah! I don't want to see Sekai acting all bashful like this!
Don't mind Hikari. Now, then, get set to start answering my questions!
And just who are you supposed to be?
Tsk. Buy us some time with your class rep privileges.
I guess it can't be helped. We'll pick up again at lunchtime!
Because I'm having lunch with Sekai.
Fine, I'll just ask Sekai afterwards. You don't mind, right, Sekai?
Not that I'm crazy about that idea either...
You'd better keep that in mind! Hmph!
Here you can see we have six disks, but to make things easier, we'll start from two.
Let's try using our handout to solve the problem. How about... Kiyoura.
With two disks, it takes three moves. With three disks, it takes seven. Four is fifteen, and five is...
This is where it gets a little difficult.
Um... five is thirty-one. Six is...
Ahh... is Sekai really going to go out with Itou after all?
That's what you say, but really, you're relieved.
Yeah. Deep down inside, you're thinking, 'Good for her.'
Eh?! You mean you went to Aqua Square?
Doesn't seem like it, judging by that reaction. Besides, she doesn't even have one.
Go on, tell us, then. Who did you go with?
Uuh... my female cousin and my little sister.
Still, I'm envious! They've got all sorts of pools there, right?
Yeah, yeah! The water slide was awesome.
Otome, are you eating at the cafeteria today?

File.name: 04-SE-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, setting aside the question of whether you both like each other... that was just unbelievable.
You gather your courage and talk to him...
But then the girl next to him gets in the way, and you end up tragically rejected.
Uh-huh. I went and got some medicine. So, what's this about?
Well, Otome was talking with that boyfriend of hers just now.
We just happened to have gone to the pool on the same day. It's not as if we arranged to go together...
besides, when you put it like that, it sounds like I actually met him there.
She's been dedicated to him since junior high, you know.
Still, isn't that kind of, like, destiny?
So, that guy from class 3... what was his name again?
So, she was about to have lunch with Itou, and that girl from class 3 got in the way, so Otome ended up being rejected.
Oh, you know. The energetic one who kind of stands out... I think her name is Saionji?
So, she gets in the way, and Otome is just like, 'Well, I'll be going over there...' before coming back to us, right?
It almost looked as though Saionji-san and Itou were going out together.
Aww... if it was going to be such a fun lunch, I wish I could have been there.
You couldn't help it if you didn't feel well. How many days has it been now?
You always seem to have it so bad. You poor girl.
If the medicine doesn't work, you should just go home early.
"It's all a misunderstanding.\nDon't be so mad."

File.name: 04-SE-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sekai: "You can't just buy me off like that."\nMakoto: "In that case, let me treat you to something."
"See? You ARE mad. How does Pure Burger sound?"
"I'll forgive you...\nif you make it a set meal with a lychee shake."

File.name: 04-SE-D03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "Not that I'm mad, but do you want me to forgive you?"
Sekai: "Yes."\nMakoto: "Then let's go to Pure Burger together after class."

File.name: 04-SE-D04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "Could it be...\nthat I was so angry that I made you angry too?"
"Hey... I was just teasing.\nDon't get mad, okay?"
Sekai: "I'm not really angry."\nMakoto: "Are you sure?"
"I was just thinking about after class."
"I was thinking we could go to Pure Burger together."

File.name: 04-SE-D05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hey, Makoto. On the way home, let's... uwah!
Yeah, yeah. Get over here, Sawanaga.
You've been invited to a dazzling session of cleaning duty with three beautiful girls.
What the heck does that mean?!

File.name: 04-SE-D06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, I stayed up until dawn on the phone again last night...
Haha, I'm surprised you can keep it up. I went straight to sleep after I got home yesterday.
I should have done the same... fwah.
Mmn... it's because you wouldn't call me.
I was waiting for you to call.
Well, don't worry about it. It wasn't your fault I stayed up late on the phone.

File.name: 04-SE-D07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah... look, don't misunderstand. We were just talking about our memories from junior high.

File.name: 04-SE-D09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You were speaking with someone who you can't te... huh?

File.name: 04-SE-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's been a while since we've eaten in the classroom.
We used to always go up to the roof, didn't we?
Well, with the colder days we've been getting lately, we'll have to stop going so often.
I guess we could just put on a coat and tough it out.
Ah, speaking of coats, there's one I've got my eye on right now.
It's this cute, fluffy one with fake fur!
I'd like to see that. Once you buy it, let's eat on the roof while dressed up all fluffy-like.
Oh, Katou. I don't often see you coming to class 3. What's up?
I'm handing out flyers for my club. Oh, by the way...
Hey... have you been to Aqua Square recently?
I went on the same day that you did.
My little sister says she saw someone who looked like you.
Ah. Karen, huh? Is she doing well?
She's been studying every day, saying that she wants to try for our school.
Ahahah... she's also a big sports player who's bad at studying, isn't she?
Also? You're talking as if I can't study either.
What are you talking about? When we took the exams, you were whimpering while studying, just like me.
Well, I guess... that sure brings back memories. We studied together, didn't we?
Not that it helped much, with everyone messing around the whole time.
Sorry. Well, I'll be going over there.
So you say, but you never follow up.
Really, I will. See you later.
Oh, my classmate from junior high. Her name's Katou.
What is it? Do you know her?
She's from class 4, so you have P.E. together, right? Maybe you've seen her there before.
It looks like there's something bothering you...
You two are pretty close, aren't you...? After all, you mentioned you studied for the exams together.

File.name: 04-SE-E01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She was one of the people I really got along with in junior high. Yeah, those sure were some fun times.
More fun than now, I'll bet.
It's not like that, stupid. At our junior high, boys and girls were just friends. That's what our relationship was like.
What are you talking about? Like I said, it wasn't like that.

File.name: 04-SE-E02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You studied together and went out together with her family, right?
Are you misunderstanding something here? Katou isn't my girlfriend.
It's not like that with her. She's more like... a close friend?
You seem to be pretty close to her little sister, too.
Her sister's one year below us, so back in junior high, she used to hang out with us all the time.
Look! Don't think of it like that. It's not.

File.name: 04-SE-E03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So... you were going out with her after all.
Is Katou-san your girlfriend from junior high?
Wha-! No, it's not like that.
It's not like that, stupid. At our junior high, boys and girls were just friends. She was just someone I did things with.
I told you, it's not like that! Believe me!

File.name: 04-SE-E04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haah... we boys have basketball today, but I think I might have hurt my knee a little... ow...
You seem kind of down, huh?
Is it because of yesterday's conversation with Kotonoha?
There's that, but... you and your g... no, it's nothing.
Ah... come to think of it...
I heard that you've been asking about her.
Oh, Katou told me just then.
I knew it. You and Katou-san are...
Not this again. Just cut it out, okay? I...
I know all about it! About how you kissed at the pool and spent all night flirting on the phone... you're cheating on me!
Hey... you've got it all wrong. I haven't done any of that.
You just keep lying! I know all about it!
You say you know about it...? Seriously, you're mistaken. I don't know who's been spreading these rumors, but...
There you go again, thinking you can fool me by playing dumb... that's not fair, Makoto.
That's why you won't even kiss me!
I've kissed you before, haven't I?
All you've ever done is kiss me back!
I don't know what to tell you... I'll do it later, then.
But you won't! If you really want to, then do it right here, right now!
There's no way I could do it right now. Just look around you. Everyone's looking at us...
Even though you've already had sex with Katsura-san!
I bet you've done it with Katou-san, too! Why is it that I'm the only one you don't do anything with?
Well, I mean... we've only been going out for two days...
You don't love me... you don't find someone like me attractive...
S-Sekai... calm down... l-let's talk over there, okay?

File.name: 04-SE-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I want to speak with Saionji-san.
Wait, aren't I the one you want to talk to?
It's true that I want to talk about you... but I'd like to speak alone with Saionji-san.
That's all right... but will you be okay on your own?
This all started because I was the one who introduced her to you... I think that I have to be the one who settles it.
Don't worry, I'll call you once I'm home.

File.name: 04-SE-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So, what did you want to talk about?
He... said that he was going to see the person he loved.
He said that he was sorry... that there was someone he loved long before he met me.
Did you know that Makoto-kun was in love with someone else?
Y-yes... um... I wasn't sure... but kind of.
Yes... the truth is, I don't know who it is, and it's really been bothering me.
Eh? Didn't Makoto tell you who it was?
No. He... simply said it was someone he's loved for some time.
So, last night, I couldn't sleep and was thinking about it... about who it was that Makoto-kun loved.
U-um... well, actually, that person is m...
I was thinking of killing her, and then myself!
That's why I've brought this fruit knife here from home.
I thought I'd stick this knife in her throat and... twist a little. Then, I'd slit my own throat, and we'd die together...
I didn't want to leave this person who Makoto-kun loves alive,
and I didn't believe that I should continue living after I killed her, so that Makoto-kun would come to hate me, so...
U-um... y-you know, you shouldn't be so hasty.
I mean... lots of good things could happen if you just keep living, and... you'd really hurt that person... you know.
Do you know who it is that Makoto-kun loves?
She plays basketball, so she's quite fit, and big, too. I didn't think that I could stab someone like her to death...
Katou-san... you mean that girl Makoto knows from junior high?
Yes. You seem to know a lot about her.
Well... only what I've heard from Makoto.
It came to me when I thought about how she was a girl that Makoto-kun knew before he met me, and how close they are.
No, there's no mistaking it. I'm certain.
Yes. The truth is... we went to Aqua Square last weekend, didn't we?
Katou-san went there, too. On the same day.
Eh...?! But isn't that just a coincidence?
That isn't what the problem is.
I know that Makoto-kun kissed a stranger on the beach.
It was right before I brought some juice to him. When I arrived, there was no one there, so I'm sure of it.
No, I'm not. All this time, I've been wondering who it was. It turns out it was Katou-san.
Have you heard anyone mention that Makoto-kun and Katou-san met at Aqua Square?
This would be the first time...
It is for me, too. And yet, I... heard Katou-san tell her friends that she met him at Aqua Square.
And so, I thought, 'Now I know who Makoto-kun was kissing.'
I only happened to overhear them... but why would she lie to her friends about something so trivial?
Katou-san said something else while telling her friends about the pool...
She didn't just happen to meet him there. She's liked him ever since junior high.
Neither do I. If it's Katou-san... then I really don't know...
I don't know... I just don't know... Makoto...

File.name: 04-SE-H02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Do you know Katou-san from class 4?
Yeah. We're both in the girls' basketball club.
What's she like? She's a nice girl. She likes to lead, so she kind of acts as the head of the girls in class 4. Hey, Otome.
Wawah! You don't have to call her over.
Hello... ah, you're the girl I met at lunch yesterday.
You were having lunch with Itou, right?
We used to hang out together.
Ah... and now that you're in the basketball club, you've become too busy?
There's that, but it's been hard to gather the guys from junior high now that we're in high school.
Ah, I know what you mean!
Weren't you the only one on a sports scholarship from Harami junior high?
That's got nothing to do with friendship. Aww, I feel so lonely. Come on, former teammates...
More importantly, have you heard about the list of today's activities?
Yeah, I know. What's with that? It's way too harsh.
Katou-san... she really did have that air of being a girlfriend about her, didn't she?
She's been even more cheerful since she started going out with Makoto-kun... no one in our class can compare.
Uh-huh... she's nice and slim from playing basketball, and they're about the same height too. They look good together.

File.name: 04-SE-H03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The rumors have spread all over class now.
Before I knew it, I had become the guy who was cheating on Katou...
Most of the rumors are probably about how I'm the evil playboy who's stringing along Kotonoha and Sekai...
I thought I loved Sekai... that I'd go out with her... that I'd be with her... and yet...
Just how did things end up like this...?
How did I end up like this...? I don't understand it at all.
Can't we... talk things over properly?
Shall we go up to the roof?
Ooh, they just said they were going up to the roof, didn't they?

File.name: 04-SE-I00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Today... I heard a very tired Katou-san tell her friends how she stayed up all night doing this and that with Makoto-kun.
I suppose this means... they're in that kind of relationship, doesn't it? Staying over until morning... how indecent...
They were on the phone until dawn.
Eh...?! Ah... r-r-really...? Oh, no, I... really thought that...
Still, they're close enough to be on the phone all the way until morning...
U-um... I've been thinking of trying harder, so that I won't lose to her. What do you think?
Really?! Oh, it makes me feel a hundred times braver to hear you say that.
Yes... I'm going to try my hardest.

File.name: 04-SE-J00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Listen... everyone's been looking at me and whispering since around the end of lunch... do you know anything?
Well, the thing is... you know my friend, Saionji Sekai, who spoke to you after P.E., right?
Y-yeah... I thought they seemed close, but...
So, some lines got crossed, and now it seems she thinks that Itou is cheating on her with someone else.
So... to put it bluntly, Sekai thinks that he's cheating on her with you.
Done anything that comes to mind?
Yeah, I thought so... but given the way she blew up in front of everyone, it spread like wildfire.
It's not just you. People are saying that he's also cheating with Katsura from your class.
Well, in her case, she's been sending out pheromones full force. I think Sekai just saw her and had a misunderstanding.
It's a misunderstanding in my case, too!
The rumors say you've kissed him, spent the night with him and done plenty more.
I haven't! I haven't done any of that stuff!
Mmn... you were speaking with Itou at lunch, right?
I was just thinking that maybe you like him.
It's just a one-sided thing! Itou... is really dense when it comes to stuff like that.
Well, I'm Sekai's friend, so I don't intend to encourage you, but...
...but I think that you and Itou would make a nice couple.
If Sekai gets dumped, I'll be supporting you.
Right! Now, then, let's go to club!

File.name: 04-SE-K00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I... I'm here because I want to hear what you have to say.
I've said everything I have to say. This time, it's my turn to listen to your excuses.
What do you mean, excuses?! You're the one making false accusations!
They're not false! I've got evidence!
Saw me kiss Katou, you mean?
Don't be ridiculous! Where'd you find a liar like that?!
She's not a liar. She's trustworthy.
Katsura-san said so. She said you dumped her but didn't tell her who for, so she investigated... and it was Katou-san.
Eh...? Didn't I tell her that I was going out with you?
No, you didn't! She said she tried her best to figure it out herself, because she didn't know!
That's odd... b-but she knows, right? That I'm going out with you.
Maybe she would, if you really were.
There you go again, talking like that.
You look so happy when you talk about her... but when you talk to me, you're always frowning.
That's because you keep making accusations.
It's not like I want to! But it's your fault for making me feel this way...
What do you mean? Like I said, I haven't done anything.
You have... and now, you're lying.
What, so you don't trust me?!
Haah... there you go, crying again...
Anyhow, the fact that Kotonoha says that I kissed Katou...
No matter who you love... I just can't forget about you.
Eh...? B-but... look, Katou and I...
Makoto-kun... please... go out... with me again.
Didn't you say that you'd support me too, Saionji-san?
She did! This morning, at P.E.
All we talked about was Katou-san, so...
I said I'd try harder so that I wouldn't lose to Katou-san, and you said it was a good idea, didn't you?
So with the courage that I received from Saionji-san, I thought I'd try confessing to you one more time.
Sekai... you were willing to let me go out with Kotonoha again?
He's not wrong! You said it yourself, didn't you?!
Makoto-kun... please. Go out with me!

File.name: 04-SE-K01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I... just don't know how I feel anymore.
In that case, you should go out with...
No... right now, I'm not going to go out with anyone.
I'm going to calm down and think about things...

File.name: 04-SE-K02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's not Katou. The girl I kissed at the pool was her, too.
I'm sorry... I didn't tell you.
Please... believe in these feelings of mine.

File.name: 04-SE-K03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I thought that I was in love with Sekai... but I just don't know anymore.
I... still can't decide whether I'll go out with you...
...I don't hate you either, Kotonoha, but...
Give me a little time to consider it.
I want to find the proper answer... to who it is that I love.

File.name: 04-SF-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I don't think I can go on.

File.name: 04-SG-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I wonder... if Makoto-kun was pleased?
It was so embarrassing... but that's the sort of thing that makes boys happy, isn't it?
We'll be able to go out together again, won't we...?
From: Itou Makoto\n"I don't think things are working between us. To be honest, there's someon else that I love. I'm sorry for not telling you earlier, and I'm sorry if I've hurt you."

File.name: 04-SG-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's another nice day today, isn't it? Even if it is a little cold.
Are you... free to have lunch with me today...?
Did you buy some bread or something to bring today?
No, I overslept, so I was just thinking of buying something from the cafeteria.
Why don't we eat in the classroom, then?
Here you can see we have six disks, but to make things easier, we'll start from two.
Let's try using our handout to solve the problem. How about... Kiyoura.
With two disks, it takes three moves. With three disks, it takes seven. Four is fifteen, and five is...
This is where it gets a little difficult.
Um... five is thirty-one. Six is...
Ahh... is Sekai really going to go out with Itou after all?
That's what you say, but really, you're relieved.
Yeah. Deep down inside, you're thinking, 'Good for her.'
Eh?! You mean you went to Aqua Square?
Doesn't seem like it, judging by that reaction. Besides, she doesn't even have one.
Go on, tell us, then. Who did you go with?
Uuh... my female cousin and my little sister.
Still, I'm envious! They've got all sorts of pools there, right?
Yeah, yeah! The water slide was awesome.
Otome, are you eating at the cafeteria today?
